production.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. The input is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not the desired atlas content. Create a different production sprite atlas containing EIGHT CROP PLANTS in 4 equal columns and 2 equal rows, isolated on true alpha transparency. Use exactly the chunky, glossy, simple cartoon painting of the input's produce crate and apple tree: very broad round shapes, clean warm-brown outlines, smooth gradients, simple rounded leaves with at most one vein, broad creamy upper-left highlights. NOT botanical illustration, not detailed realistic leaves, no tiny texture or hairline stems. These must read clearly as ripe crops when each is only 45 pixels tall. TOP ROW left to right: one dense clump of five short thick golden wheat ears; one fat orange carrot ROOT with its orange body occupying the lower half of the plant and a SHORT tuft of three broad leaves; one squat tomato plant with THREE LARGE glossy tomatoes dominating the silhouette and just a few round leaves; one BIG round orange pumpkin with a short stem and two broad leaves. BOTTOM ROW: compact strawberry plant with THREE LARGE red berries and three broad leaves; a SHORT corn plant with TWO FAT golden cobs dominating the plant and four simple leaves; TWO LARGE purple grape bunches with three leaves and a SHORT wooden vine support; one big round striped watermelon with two leaves and a short curling vine. Fruits and roots should occupy at least half the visible sprite, stems short, no tall trees, no tiny fruit, no pots or soil patches. Eight objects have generous transparent gutters, sit separately in their own equal cells, no labels or extra objects. Actual transparent background outside silhouettes, absolutely no brown/green colored backdrop or glow.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE game-ready painted PROP sprite atlas, exactly 12 isolated cutout sprites arranged in 4 equal columns and 3 equal rows. Match glossy casual farming-game buildings: chunky rounded shapes, warm brown outlines, smooth hand-painted gradients, broad golden upper-left highlights, rich but gentle lower-right shading, honey wood, cream stone, softened greens. A little elevated frontal view, not isometric. Exact order left to right: ROW ONE: small stone well with wooden posts and a red terracotta pitched roof, no bucket dangling outside; wooden rectangular planter filled with pink and cream flowers; simple honey-wood garden bench; tied golden rectangular hay bale. ROW TWO: rustic wooden wheelbarrow holding a few vegetables; neat pile of six cut logs with visible round ends; group of three cream grain sacks tied at top; small cluster of two rounded gray warm stones. ROW THREE: slender brass garden lamp on a wooden post with a small warm yellow lantern; a horizontal pair of honey-wood fence rails with NO vertical posts and plain squared ends suitable to repeat seamlessly; ONE upright thick honey-wood fence post with a rounded bevelled cap; cream stone windmill tower with terracotta conical cap, small door and round window but absolutely NO blades or rotating sails (the game adds those). No extra objects, no characters, no words, no labels, no dividers. Each object must be entirely contained within its cell with generous transparent margin, no touching or overlapping cells. Actual alpha transparency outside every object, no colored background, backdrop shadow or vignette. Props will be displayed at 35 to 100 pixels tall, so simple bold silhouettes, no fine detail.

No large stones, trees, plants, objects, flowers, focal point, lighting hotspot, perspective, cast shadows, horizon, labels, text, vignettes, borders, lines between quadrants or transparency. Texture only, softly painted, no photographic detail and no noise.

draft.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent production sprite atlas for a polished painted farming game. Exactly eight mature CROP PLANTS in a strict 4-column by 2-row grid, one plant per equal cell, no cell borders, big transparent gutters. Order left to right TOP: ripe wheat clump with five broad golden ears; carrot plant with orange root emerging just above ground and lush green leaves; tomato plant with short leafy stem and three glossy red tomatoes; pumpkin plant with short curling vine, leaves and one round orange pumpkin. BOTTOM: compact strawberry plant with leaves and three red strawberries; corn plant with short leafy stalk and two golden cobs; grape vine with leaves and two purple grape bunches on a small wooden support; watermelon plant with short leafy vine and one striped green melon. These are standing plants seen from a slightly elevated frontal game view, not loose item icons, no pots, no soil platforms. Match a warm casual farming illustration: smooth rich painted shading, rounded chunky silhouettes, restrained warm-brown outlines, broad upper-left golden highlights, soft lower-right shadows, clean shapes readable at 45 pixels tall. Keep highlights gentle: Ravi the farmer is the visual focus of the eventual game. Each plant occupies the central 65% of its cell and has its ground-contact point centered near the bottom. Actual alpha transparency outside all eight silhouettes, no background color or colored haze, no labels, text, extra objects or shadows on the backdrop.
